name: Jordan Fall Open 2021

venue.name: Omareyah School
venue.address: Omareyah School, Ayaman Ramdan St 3, Amman, Jordan
venue.details: It's a school theater in the ground floor of a capacity of 500 people

information: The Jordan Fall Open 2021 is an official speedcubing competition of the World Cube Association (WCA). Speedcubing involves solving the 3x3x3 Cube or similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors, regardless of experience and skill, but time limits will be imposed in order to keep to the schedule and complete the days on time. No previous experience of WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA rules.
